Section 3 (App shell) is implemented and verified end-to-end on the iOS Simulator:

- `ns build ios` succeeds.
- Home shows title `Native Bench`, subtitle `Token economics benchmark`, and `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons that navigate correctly.
- Health and Transcribe screens match their spec placeholders exactly (status lines, enabled `Request Access`, disabled second button, section header/empty states), and both navigate back to Home via the automatic iOS back button.

No native platform calls were added — everything is static per phase 1 scope. Files touched: `app/components/Home.vue` (rewritten), `app/components/Health.vue` and `app/components/Transcribe.vue` (new). `SPEC.md` and `spec-assets/` were left untouched.
